description: Crystal cracks with light (f0), the light bursts out (f1), streams back along the arc (f2-5), the creature re-forms with a wind release (f6-9). CODE: reveal the foe with hooks.foe_reform on f6-9; crystal stays in the hands, dim.
status: DRAFT - not approved by Gary, NOT wired into game code
background: fully transparent (1-bit alpha), palette-only opaque pixels
loop: play ONCE in game (remove after total_ms)
sheet_layout: horizontal strip, frame i at x=i*frame_w

anchor.usage: authored for the pilot 320x240 layout: draw the frame top-left at canvas_top_left_on_screen (x k). Other layouts: the arc runs HOLD -> foe centre with control point [148, 60]

emissive: all (all = draw with the ToD lit grade)

hand_anchor.sprite_px: TBD by Character models: the raised-hands point in each player back-sprite raise frame (x, y in sprite px)

foe_anchor.rule: foe sprite visual centre; rune ring radii 34 x 30 px around it

foe_reform.method: reverse Bayer; play the cry on frame 6; battle shake (soul/battle_feedback shake strong_hit) optional on frame 6
